drink.name: Name
drink.commentPlaceholder: Taste, smell, who you were with…
drink.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}” and its photo? This can't be undone.

list.empty: No drinks yet. Add the first one!

photo.none: No photo yet. Take one, pick one, or scan the barcode.
photo.cropHint: Drag to move, pinch or use the slider to zoom.
photo.blurry: The photo looks blurry. Take it again if the label can't be read.

barcode.title: Scan barcode
barcode.hint: Hold the barcode inside the picture, 10–20 cm away.
barcode.noCamera: The camera couldn't be started here. Read the code from a photo or type it instead.
barcode.notFound: No barcode found in that photo.
barcode.unknown: {{code}} isn't in the databases. Fill in the rest yourself.
barcode.savedOffline: Barcode {{code}} saved. Look it up when you're online.

ocr.working: Reading the label on the phone (the first time downloads ~20 MB)…
ocr.tapToUse: Text on the label – tap to use as the name:
ocr.nothing: No text found. Crop closer to the label and try again.

outbox.uploading: They're sent as soon as there's a connection.
outbox.offline: You're offline. They're sent when you're back online.
outbox.savedOffline: Saved on the phone. It uploads by itself when you're online.
outbox.photoQueued: The drink is saved; the photo uploads when the connection is better.

offline.banner: You're offline. Showing what was loaded last; new drinks are saved and uploaded later.

profile.addEmail: Add an email address to be able to reset your password.
profile.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other phones are logged out.

push.title: Notifications
push.enabled: Notifications are on for this device.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in the phone's or browser's settings.
push.unsupported: This browser can't get push notifications.
push.homeScreen: On iPhone, add the site to the home screen first (Share → Add to Home Screen), then open it from there.
push.nativeUnavailable: Push to the app isn't set up on this server yet.
push.cheers: Someone cheers to one of my drinks
push.adminSignup: Push: a new user signs up
push.adminSignupEmail: Email: a new user signs up

auth.forgotText: Enter the email address on your account and we'll send you a link.
auth.resetSent: If there's an account with that address, a link is on its way.
auth.resetDone: Your password has been changed. You can log in now.
auth.approvalNote: An admin approves new accounts before they can add drinks.
auth.passwordRules: At least 8 characters, not only numbers, not too common.
auth.serverHint: For example øl.cer06.no. Must use HTTPS.

pending.title: Welcome, {{name}}!
pending.text: Your account is waiting for an admin to approve it. You'll get an email when it's done.

admin.passwordHint: The user is logged out of the phone apps.
admin.deleteText: The account is deleted. Their drinks stay, without a name, unless you tick the box.
admin.publicViewHint: Anyone with the link can see drinks, stats and the calendar without logging in.
admin.allowSignupHint: Otherwise only admins can add users.
admin.requireApprovalHint: Off: new accounts can add drinks at once.
admin.defaultRoleHint: Contributors add drinks and change their own; viewers only look.
admin.photoAiHint: Runs on the phone; photos aren't sent anywhere for it.
admin.lookupHint: Search from the form. Free, no keys, results cached for 30 days.
admin.offHint: Packaged beer, wine and more, with photos and barcodes.

errors.SERVER_ERROR: The server answered with an error ({{status}}).
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on the server.
errors.NOT_APPROVED: Your account is waiting for approval.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You're not allowed to do that.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} minute(s).
errors.INVALID_USERNAME: Usernames can have letters, digits and @/./+/-/_ only.
errors.INVALID_RESET_LINK: The link is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.SIGNUP_CLOSED: New accounts can only be made by an admin.
errors.DATE_IN_FUTURE: The date can't be in the future.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Something in the form isn't valid.
errors.INVALID_IMAGE: That file isn't a photo the server can read.
errors.URL_NOT_ALLOWED: Pictures can only be imported from the drink databases.
errors.LAST_ADMIN: There must be at least one admin.
errors.CANNOT_CHANGE_SELF: You can't do that to your own account.
errors.PUSH_UNAVAILABLE: Push to the app isn't set up on this server.
